d:
Paranprik tarike se banaen jhatpat kale chane (Kala Chana) aur halva (Suji Halwa) banane ka aasan va sahi tarika, jo kanya pujan ya bhandare ke lie parphekt hai.
How to make authentic and easy Kala Chana and Halwa for Kanya Pujan during Navratri Ashtami and Navami. Step-by-step method with tips for perfect taste.
Ingredients for Sooji Halwa
Ghi - Ghee - ½ cup
Badam - Almond - 2 tbsp
Kaju - Cashews - 2 tbsp
Kishmish - Raisins - 2 tbsp
Suji - Semolina - ½ cup (100g)
